title: ci: run router nextjs e2e in ci
body:
**Summary**

This PR adds a CI job that runs e2e tests that target `react-instantsearch-router-nextjs` in Saucelabs.

It is designed to be run on master and on a daily schedule, like `e2e tests`. It is run separately, to benefit from parallelization.

While technically not reliant on the `examples` job, I still left it as a dependency just to keep the e2e jobs together (but it's a subjective choice, i'm open to discussing this).

[**See successful job →**](https://app.circleci.com/pipelines/github/algolia/instantsearch/9178/workflows/8b526154-10cf-46e8-8e37-3abfdfd98ac9)
